_why: PLUGINRESERVE1 (D64 rule 3; .claude/knowledge/twins.md): the harness names this build runs, which no plugin may declare, one table both twins are held to. Every name either side runs as a harness is reserved, so no plugin's harness can shadow a built-in one: each door the driver's built set carries (AdapterSet.Built()), each agent a door runs as that has no door of its own (its holders: `codex` since CODEXACCT1, whose sign-in and status question a plugin named `codex` would otherwise take over), and the two gate stubs. `reserved` is the list, in ordinal order: the driver's AdapterSet.Built().Reserved and PluginCatalog.Reserved are each held to it exactly, as the CLI's reservedHarnesses() (its TOOLCHAINS' keys and the stubs) was until it left with `daoris plugin`'s TypeScript (PUSH1f2f, D194). `declares`: why, a plugin's harness name, and whether each catalogue refuses the plugin for it as one this build carries, compared without case. A name added to the adapters alone fails PluginCatalogTests.
